about: The official Irish sources Dublin Buddy (the AI assistant, Backend/chat.py) points to for laws and rules that change: visas and work rules, tenancy law and rent rules, tax, wages, health and fares. (With CHAT_WEB_SEARCH=on, which costs extra, it also searches these domains live.) check_official_pages.py checks the pages below every week: when one changes, a GitHub issue asks the team to review the assistant and the Things to know page. After reviewing, update last_reviewed.

topics.topic: Student visas, IRP registration and renewal (Stamp 2)
Work rules for non-EEA students (hours in term and holidays)
Renting: tenants' rights, deposits, rent increases and notice periods
Tax when starting work (Revenue myAccount, PPS)
Public transport fares and the Student Leap Card
